characters.name: Avatar Infernas
characters.description: Starts with extra Arcana XIX - Heart of Fire. Grows stronger with every level, but also loses control.
characters.unlockShort: It is tangible only in the inverted Inlaid Library. Good friends might then show the way.
characters.unlockGuide:
After clearing Eudaimonia Machine by defeating The Directer and obtaining the Greatest Jubilee, the player must start a run in Inlaid Library with inverse mode enabled.
* The player must then travel far to the right of the stage, past the Gold Ring, until they encounter The Trickster in front of a piano. If the player moves out of view of The Trickster, it will simply teleport to the other side of the screen.
* After killing The Trickster, interact with the piano by moving in front of its keys; doing so will pause the game and open an interactive pop-up menu with clickable piano keys. If the player has Peachone and Ebony Wings, the birds will fly towards the keys that must be pressed and continuously cycle through each note. Keep in mind they are not necessary to have if the player already knows which keys to press.
** It is also important to remember that the Vandalier and the hidden Peachone and Ebony Wings that Cosmo Pavone starts with cannot be used. To avoid evolving the bird weapons into the Vandalier, it is recommended to Banish one of them to prevent it from reaching level 8, or the Vandalier can be Sealed before starting the run.
* The keys the player must press are: D, A, A#, G, and C# (2nd white key, 6th white key, 5th black key, 5th white key, and the 1st black key).
* After playing the final note, the player will then be teleported to a dark area that infinitely spawns Undead Heads and Undead Eyes. This area contains nine coffins in a square grid around the player, which can be seen on the map.
* One of these coffins contains Avatar Infernas, while the rest are empty, and is randomized in each run. After opening the coffin containing Avatar Infernas, the darkness will fade, all of the remaining enemies disappear, and the now hostile Avatar Infernas will spawn and slowly chase the player. Defeating the hostile Avatar Infernas unlocks him as a playable character and causes the White Hand to appear and end the run.
Avatar Infernas does not normally need to be purchased and is immediately available upon completion of the secret.
Alternatively, Avatar Infernas can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "kalvasflam". This will require the player to purchase Avatar Infernas for 666, which scales with other characters purchased.

phases.title: Phase 0 — Preparation
phases.intro: Before attempting this, make sure you have:

items.text: Eudaimonia Machine cleared
children: Defeat The Directer and obtain the Greatest Jubilee relic.

phases.note: Then start a run in Inlaid Library with Inverse Mode enabled.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Find the Trickster and play the piano
phases.intro: Travel far to the right of the stage, past the Gold Ring:

items.text: Find The Trickster
children: It's standing in front of a piano.
Moving out of its view makes it teleport to the other side of the screen — approach carefully.

items.text: Kill The Trickster
Interact with the piano
children: Move in front of its keys — this pauses the game and opens a clickable piano pop-up.

items.text: Press the keys D, A, A#, G, C#, in order
children: That's the 2nd white key, 6th white key, 5th black key, 5th white key, and 1st black key.
If you have Peachone and Ebony Wings (not evolved into Vandalier), the birds fly to and cycle through the correct keys for you — but they're not required if you already know the sequence.
The Vandalier and Cosmo Pavone's hidden starting Peachone/Ebony Wings can't be used for this — Banish one of the birds or Seal the Vandalier beforehand to avoid an accidental evolution.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Defeat the hostile Avatar Infernas
phases.intro: After playing the final note:

items.text: Teleport to a dark area
children: It's infinitely spawning Undead Heads and Undead Eyes, with nine coffins arranged in a square around you (visible on the map).

items.text: Open the coffin containing Avatar Infernas
children: Only one of the nine has him — it's randomized every run.
The darkness fades and the remaining enemies disappear once you find it.

items.text: Defeat the hostile Avatar Infernas
children: He slowly chases you after the coffin opens.
Defeating him unlocks him as a playable character and ends the run via the White Hand.

phases.note: Avatar Infernas is normally playable immediately after this, with no purchase needed — some versions instead list a 666-coin purchase price that scales with the number of characters already bought.

pt.rule: Resolve o puzzle do piano na Inlaid Library invertida e derrota o Avatar Infernas hostil escondido num de nove caixões.

phases.title: Fase 0 — Preparação
phases.intro: Antes de tentares isto, garante que tens:

items.text: Eudaimonia Machine concluída
children: Derrotar o The Directer e obter a relíquia Greatest Jubilee.

phases.note: Depois, começa uma run em Inlaid Library com o Modo Inverso activado.

phases.title: Fase 1 — Encontra o Trickster e toca o piano
phases.intro: Viaja bem para a direita da fase, para lá do Gold Ring:

items.text: Encontrar o Trickster
children: Está de pé em frente a um piano.
Sair do seu campo de visão faz com que se teletransporte para o outro lado do ecrã — aproxima-te com cuidado.

items.text: Matar o Trickster
Interagir com o piano
children: Coloca-te em frente às teclas — isto pausa o jogo e abre um pop-up de piano clicável.

items.text: Carregar nas teclas D, A, A#, G, C#, por ordem
children: Ou seja: a 2.ª tecla branca, a 6.ª tecla branca, a 5.ª tecla preta, a 5.ª tecla branca e a 1.ª tecla preta.
Se tiveres o Peachone e o Ebony Wings (sem estarem evoluídos em Vandalier), os pássaros voam e percorrem as teclas certas por ti — mas não são obrigatórios se já souberes a sequência.

O Vandalier e o Peachone/Ebony Wings escondidos com que a Cosmo Pavone começa não podem ser usados aqui — Banish um dos pássaros ou Seal o Vandalier antecipadamente para evitar uma evolução acidental.

phases.title: Fase 2 — Derrota o Avatar Infernas hostil
phases.intro: Depois de tocares a última nota:

items.text: Teletransporte para uma área escura
children: Nela aparecem infinitamente Undead Heads e Undead Eyes, com nove caixões dispostos num quadrado à tua volta (visíveis no mapa).

items.text: Abrir o caixão que contém o Avatar Infernas
children: Só um dos nove o tem — é aleatório em cada run.
A escuridão desaparece e os restantes inimigos somem assim que o encontras.

items.text: Derrotar o Avatar Infernas hostil
children: Persegue-te lentamente depois de o caixão abrir.
Derrotá-lo desbloqueia-o como personagem jogável e termina a run através da White Hand.

phases.note: Normalmente, o Avatar Infernas fica jogável de imediato, sem precisar de compra — algumas versões mostram, em vez disso, um preço de 666 moedas, valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.unlockShort: It's as simple as ABC: obtain the ring of rings.
characters.unlockGuide:

Afterward, the player must travel to the ring of nine Gold Rings located to the northeast of their spawning location, which can be tracked by arrows on the screen. Upon collecting all nine Gold Rings, Bats Bats Bats is unlocked as a playable character.
Once unlocked, Bats Bats Bats can be purchased for 5000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Bats Bats Bats can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "whydithavetobebats".

characters.name: Big Trouser
characters.description: Gains +1% Greed every level. Gold Fever lasts longer.
characters.unlockShort: Master all 16 accessories in Moongolow.
characters.unlockGuide:
The player must start a run in Moongolow, collect all 16 standard stage items, and level them all up to their maximum level. After the run is left by quitting it manually or by being teleported to and completing Holy Forbidden, Big Trouser is unlocked as a playable character.
Because Tirajisú is lost once both of the revives have been used, ending the run through death will result in not having a Tirajisú at the end of the run if only 1 revival was left, and Big Trouser will not be unlocked.
Gains Boros is recommended for the exponential leveling. In addition, it is recommended to set the weapon limit to 1 in order to avoid diluting the item pool with weapon pickups, since Gains Boros's Heaven Sword is ample enough to handle the enemies. Characters that cannot die except by reaching the time limit are also suitable choices, such as Megalo Menya Moonspell and Ghost Lino.
Once unlocked, Big Trouser can be purchased for 5,000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Big Trouser can be unlocked in Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "earrivatolarrotino".

en.rule: Collect and max out all 16 standard Moongolow stage items in a single run, then end it without losing Tirajisú.

phases.title: Phase 0 — Preparation
phases.intro: Recommended, not required:

items.text: Gains Boros
children: Its exponential leveling makes maxing out 16 items much faster.

items.text: Or an invincible character
children: One that can only die from the time limit, like Megalo Menya Moonspell or Ghost Lino.

items.text: Set your weapon limit to 1
children: Keeps weapon pickups from diluting the item pool — Gains Boros's Heaven Sword alone is enough to handle enemies.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Max out all 16 items
phases.intro: Start a run in Moongolow:

items.text: Collect all 16 standard stage items
Level every one of them to its maximum level

phases.title: Phase 2 — End the run correctly

items.text: Quit manually, or complete the run via Holy Forbidden
children: Either ends the run and unlocks Big Trouser as a playable character.

items.text: Don't end it by dying with Tirajisú's revives already used up
children: Tirajisú is lost once both of its revives are spent — dying after that means you no longer have it (or your full set of maxed items) at the end of the run, and Big Trouser won't unlock.

phases.note: Once unlocked, Big Trouser can be purchased for 5,000, which scales with other characters purchased.

pt.rule: Apanha e maximiza os 16 itens de fase base de Moongolow na mesma run, e termina-a sem perderes o Tirajisú.

phases.title: Fase 0 — Preparação
phases.intro: Recomendado, mas não obrigatório:

items.text: Gains Boros
children: A sua subida de nível exponencial torna muito mais rápido maximizar 16 itens.

items.text: Ou uma personagem invencível
children: Uma que só possa morrer pelo limite de tempo, como a Megalo Menya Moonspell ou o Ghost Lino.

items.text: Define o limite de armas para 1
children: Evita que apanhares armas dilua o pool de itens — o Heaven Sword do Gains Boros sozinho já chega para lidar com os inimigos.

phases.title: Fase 1 — Maximiza os 16 itens
phases.intro: Começa uma run em Moongolow:

items.text: Apanha os 16 itens de fase base
Sobe cada um deles até ao nível máximo

phases.title: Fase 2 — Termina a run correctamente

items.text: Sai manualmente, ou completa a run através do Holy Forbidden
children: Qualquer uma das opções termina a run e desbloqueia o Big Trouser como personagem jogável.

items.text: Não termines a run morrendo depois de gastares as duas revives do Tirajisú
children: O Tirajisú perde-se assim que as suas duas revives são usadas — morrer depois disso significa que já não o tens (nem o conjunto completo de itens maximizados) no final da run, e o Big Trouser não desbloqueia.

phases.note: Depois de desbloqueado, o Big Trouser custa 5000 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.name: Boon Marrabbio
characters.unlockShort: Follow the trail after pillaging Pummarola and Skull O'Maniac from the Mad Forest.
characters.unlockGuide:
After obtaining the Yellow Sign, the player must start a run in Mad Forest and remove the Skull O'Maniac and Pummarola stage items. This can be accomplished by picking them up, even if they are discarded after, or by obtaining them by leveling up and getting their maximum level. When these conditions are met, Pies begin to appear and form a line towards a specific part of the map (to the left on the grid of the Hollow Heart and above Metaglio Left), where a shadowy enemy will appear; it will slowly move towards the player even if they do not travel there. Defeating it unlocks Boon Marrabbio as a playable character.
Once unlocked, Boon Marrabbio can be purchased for 666, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Boon Marrabbio can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "fettinepanate".

characters.unlockShortPt: Segue o rasto depois de saqueares o Pummarola e o Skull O'Maniac em Mad Forest.
stepsPt: Depois de obteres o Yellow Sign, começa uma run em Mad Forest e remove os itens de fase Skull O'Maniac e Pummarola.
Consegue-se apanhando-os (mesmo que depois sejam descartados) ou obtendo-os ao subir de nível até ao nível máximo.

Quando estas condições se cumprem, começam a aparecer Pies que formam uma fila até uma zona específica do mapa (à esquerda da grelha do Hollow Heart e acima do Metaglio Left), onde surge um inimigo sombrio que avança lentamente na tua direcção mesmo que não te aproximes.
Derrotá-lo desbloqueia o Boon Marrabbio como personagem jogável.
Depois de desbloqueado, custa 666 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.name: Cosmo Pavone
characters.description: Gains +1 Recovery and +1% Luck every level. Gains +1 Revival every 100 levels. Has hidden weapons.
characters.unlockShort: With a pure heart and two good friends, visit the fiery balcony in Cappella Magna.
characters.unlockGuide:
After the player has collected the Yellow Sign and unlocked Zi'Assunta Belpaese by opening her coffin, the player must start a run in Cappella Magna while playing as a character that has not picked up any Golden Eggs, as part of the "pure heart" requirement. Toggling off eggs in the character select menu does not count as having 0 eggs.
The player must then obtain Peachone and Ebony Wings, which must not be evolved into the Vandalier. After obtaining the two bird weapons, the player must travel north beyond the Crown and Tirajisú, where a Nduja Fritta Tanto can be found near a balcony. Collecting the Nduja Fritta Tanto when all of the conditions above have been met spawns Cosmo Pavone on the balcony, and the gate blocking it is removed. Approaching and interacting with Cosmo Pavone creates a flash similar to that of a Rosary and then unlocks it as a playable character.
Alternately, if The Ender has not yet been defeated, activating the battle against The Ender while standing near the balcony causes all the walls and gates to disappear, and the player can walk over and collect Cosmo Pavone immediately after the battle.
Once unlocked, Cosmo Pavone can be be purchased for 666, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Cosmo Pavone can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "lhovistoio". Note that the first letter is a lowercase "L".

If the player is using a French azerty keyboard, they will need to set your keyboard from FR to EN in Windows, and then type x)x&viia. If the player is using a macro (like AutoHotkey), they will need to put the keyboard in English (qwerty) but the macro needs to output x-x1viiq, and not x)x&viia.
Alternatively, there is a TotalCollected/65535 chance to unlock Exdash Exiviiq each time the player collects a Little Clover, where TotalCollected is how many Little Clovers are collected in the save file.
Once unlocked, Exdash Exiviiq can be purchased for 777, which scales with other characters purchased.

characters.unlockShort: Survive the Boss Rash with just one weapon.
characters.unlockGuide:
The player must start a run in Boss Rash and survive to the 15:00 mark while only using one weapon. Passive items are not counted, so the player can use as many as they so choose. Dying or exiting the run after the 15:00 time is reached unlocks Gyorunton as a playable character.. The easiest way to complete this is to unlock the Mindbender, which allows the player to limit how many weapons they can pick up. Alternatively, Game Killer (0) can be used to avoid leveling up entirely, so the player can avoid taking more weapons. Playing as an invincible character like Ghost Lino and Megalo Menya Moonspell also makes this process trivial.
Once unlocked, Gyorunton can be purchased for 5000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Gyorunton can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "secondevolution".

Morrer ou sair da run depois de chegares aos 15:00 desbloqueia o Gyorunton como personagem jogável.
A forma mais fácil de conseguir isto é desbloquear o Mindbender, que permite limitar quantas armas podes apanhar.
Jogar com uma personagem invencível, como o Ghost Lino ou a Megalo Menya Moonspell, também torna o processo trivial.
Depois de desbloqueado, custa 5000 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

phases.title: How to Unlock

items.text: The player must start a run in Boss Rash and survive to the 15:00 mark while only using one weapon.
Passive items are not counted, so the player can use as many as they so choose.
Dying or exiting the run after the 15:00 time is reached unlocks Gyorunton as a playable character..
The easiest way to complete this is to unlock the Mindbender, which allows the player to limit how many weapons they can pick up.
Playing as an invincible character like Ghost Lino and Megalo Menya Moonspell also makes this process trivial.

phases.note: Once unlocked, Gyorunton can be purchased for 5000, which scales with other characters purchased.

characters.name: Lama Ladonna
characters.description: Gains +5% Might, Move Speed, and Curse every 10 levels (max +20%).
characters.unlockShort: Survive 20 minutes with at least 10% Curse active.
characters.unlockGuide:
She is unlocked upon surviving 20 minutes with at least 10% Curse active. She needs to be purchased for 500, which scales with other characters purchased.
The actual condition for the achievement is to have any amount of Curse higher than the base value by the end of the run and in the same run survive at least 20 minutes. This means unlocking Lama can be also be achieved - besides the use of the Curse PowerUp - by obtaining Curse from Golden Eggs or passive items that grant Curse, such as Skull O'Maniac, Gold Ring (level 2+), Metaglio Right (level 2+) or Torrona's Box (level 9), either through level ups or picking them up as stage items. Due to the loose criteria, the player does not need to have the item for the full 20 minute duration, but only by the conclusion of a 20+ minute run.
Alternatively, Lama can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "superladonna".

characters.name: Leda
characters.unlockShort: Investigate the bottom of Gallo Tower.
characters.unlockGuide:
The player must start a run in Gallo Tower, and then continuously travel south. Leda will appear in the center of a room approximately 43-44 tilesets (map tiles) below the starting area. In order to be able to reach her in time, it is recommended to play as a character with high movement speed, such as Mask of the Red Death or Gazebo, or play the stage in hyper mode for the added movement speed bonus.
*As the player moves south, the screen will gradually become completely dark around the edges and the letters in the background will change from runes to the words "IAMALIVEHERE". Also once the player is 5 tilesets away from the boss the music will be replaced by ominous wind-like ambient noise.
*The player will eventually encounter a hostile Leda, who can be difficult to spot amongst everything else on screen with the player's limited vision, and she can sometimes be found stuck in a wall. Leda moves rather slowly and will not teleport to the player if she is offscreen, so it is recommended to not move away from her. Defeating Leda re-illuminates the screen and unlocks her as a playable character.
*Leda also appears at minute 31 though other possible conditions are unknown.
*If the player does not have Endless Mode, then playing in Hurry Mode is not recommended.
Once unlocked, Leda can be purchased for 666, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Leda can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "iwillneverletyouforgetaboutme".

en.rule: Travel roughly 43–44 tiles south in Gallo Tower and defeat the hostile Leda waiting there.

phases.title: Phase 0 — Preparation
phases.intro: Recommended, not required:

items.text: A high movement speed character
children: Mask of the Red Death or Gazebo work well.

items.text: Or Hyper Mode
children: The extra movement speed bonus helps you get there in time.

phases.note: If you don't have Endless Mode yet, Hurry Mode is not recommended for this Secret.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Travel south
phases.intro: Start a run in Gallo Tower and keep heading south:

items.text: Watch for the warning signs as you approach
children: The background runes change into the words "IAMALIVEHERE".
About 5 tiles before her, the music is replaced by ominous wind-like ambience.

items.text: Spot the hostile Leda
children: She appears roughly 43–44 tilesets below the starting room, in a room's center.
Your limited vision at this point can make her hard to see, and she can sometimes be stuck in a wall.
She also appears at minute 31, though other trigger conditions are unclear.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Defeat her

items.text: Don't move away from her
children: She moves slowly and won't teleport to you if she goes off-screen — losing track of her makes this much harder.

items.text: Defeat Leda
children: This re-illuminates the screen and unlocks her as a playable character.

phases.note: Once unlocked, Leda can be purchased for 666, which scales with other characters purchased.

pt.rule: Viaja cerca de 43–44 tiles para sul em Gallo Tower e derrota a Leda hostil que lá espera.

phases.title: Fase 0 — Preparação
phases.intro: Recomendado, mas não obrigatório:

items.text: Uma personagem com velocidade de movimento alta
children: A Mask of the Red Death ou a Gazebo funcionam bem.

items.text: Ou o Modo Hyper
children: O bónus extra de velocidade ajuda-te a chegar a tempo.

phases.note: Se ainda não tiveres o Modo Endless, o Modo Hurry não é recomendado para este Secret.

phases.title: Fase 1 — Viaja para sul
phases.intro: Começa uma run em Gallo Tower e continua sempre para sul:

items.text: Repara nos sinais de aviso à medida que te aproximas
children: As bordas do ecrã escurecem gradualmente.
As runas de fundo transformam-se nas palavras "IAMALIVEHERE".
Cerca de 5 tiles antes dela, a música é substituída por um som de vento sinistro.

items.text: Avista a Leda hostil
children: Aparece cerca de 43–44 tiles abaixo da sala inicial, no centro de uma sala.
A tua visão limitada nesta altura pode dificultar vê-la, e por vezes fica presa numa parede.
Também aparece ao minuto 31, embora outras condições de activação não sejam claras.

phases.title: Fase 2 — Derrota-a

items.text: Não te afastes dela
children: Move-se devagar e não se teletransporta até ti se sair do ecrã — perdê-la de vista torna tudo muito mais difícil.

items.text: Derrotar a Leda
children: Isto reilumina o ecrã e desbloqueia-a como personagem jogável.

phases.note: Depois de desbloqueada, a Leda custa 666 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

en.objective: Unlock Mask of the Red Death
en.rule: Defeat The Reaper using the Crimson Shroud + Infinite Corridor combo.

phases.title: Phase 0 — Unlock Holy Forbidden
phases.intro: Before you can even find the items for this, you need access to the Holy Forbidden stage:

items.text: Unlock Hyper Mode on 4 normal stages
children: This is what unlocks access to Moongolow.

items.text: In Moongolow, defeat its special boss without using any secret character
children: Doing this unlocks the Holy Forbidden stage.

items.text: Start a run in Holy Forbidden and collect the Yellow Sign at the 15-minute mark
children: This makes Metaglio Left, Metaglio Right, Silver Ring and Gold Ring always spawn as pickups for the rest of the run.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Evolve Crimson Shroud and Infinite Corridor
phases.intro: Level up the following, then open 2 Treasure Chests — that's what triggers both evolutions once every requirement below is met:

items.text: Crimson Shroud
children: Needs a level 7 Laurel, a level 9 Metaglio Left and a level 9 Metaglio Right.
Caps all incoming damage to 10 at a time.

items.text: Infinite Corridor
children: Needs a level 7 Clock Lancet, a level 9 Silver Ring and a level 9 Gold Ring.
Halves the health of every enemy it hits — The Reaper included.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Defeat The Reaper

items.text: Let The Reaper find you
children: With Crimson Shroud capping the damage you take and Infinite Corridor repeatedly halving its health, it goes down in a fairly short amount of time.

items.text: Defeat it
children: Doing so unlocks Mask of the Red Death as a playable character.

phases.note: Once unlocked, Mask of the Red Death can be purchased for 666, which scales with other characters purchased.

pt.objective: Desbloquear Mask of the Red Death
pt.rule: Derrota o Reaper com a combinação Crimson Shroud + Infinite Corridor.

phases.title: Fase 0 — Desbloqueia o Holy Forbidden
phases.intro: Antes de conseguires sequer procurar os itens para isto, precisas de acesso à fase Holy Forbidden:

items.text: Desbloqueia o Modo Hyper em 4 fases normais
children: É isto que desbloqueia o acesso a Moongolow.

items.text: Em Moongolow, derrota o boss especial sem usar nenhuma personagem secreta
children: Fazer isto desbloqueia a fase Holy Forbidden.

items.text: Começa uma run em Holy Forbidden e apanha o Yellow Sign aos 15 minutos
children: Isto faz com que o Metaglio Left, o Metaglio Right, o Silver Ring e o Gold Ring passem a aparecer sempre como itens de fase, no resto da run.

phases.title: Fase 2 — Evolui o Crimson Shroud e o Infinite Corridor
phases.intro: Sobe o nível dos seguintes, e depois abre 2 Treasure Chests — é isso que desencadeia ambas as evoluções, uma vez cumpridos todos os requisitos abaixo:

items.text: Crimson Shroud
children: Precisa de um Laurel no nível 7, um Metaglio Left no nível 9 e um Metaglio Right no nível 9.
Limita todo o dano recebido a 10 de cada vez.

items.text: Infinite Corridor
children: Precisa de um Clock Lancet no nível 7, um Silver Ring no nível 9 e um Gold Ring no nível 9.
Corta a vida a meio de qualquer inimigo que acerte — incluindo o Reaper.

phases.title: Fase 3 — Derrota o Reaper

items.text: Deixa o Reaper encontrar-te
children: Com o Crimson Shroud a limitar o dano que levas e o Infinite Corridor a cortar-lhe a vida a meio repetidamente, ele cai num período de tempo razoavelmente curto.

items.text: Derrota-o
children: Fazer isto desbloqueia o Mask of the Red Death como personagem jogável.

phases.note: Depois de desbloqueado, custa 666 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.unlockShortPt: Ajusta contas com o Reaper.
stepsPt: Tens de matar o Reaper.

Fazer isso desbloqueia o Mask of the Red Death como personagem jogável.
Depois de desbloqueado, custa 666 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

Once unlocked, Minnah Mannarah can be bought for 666, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Minnah Mannarah can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "foldinthecheese".

characters.name: MissingN▯
characters.unlockShort: With the most adverse fate in Green Acres, run off the edge of the world.
characters.unlockGuide:
After obtaining the Yellow Sign, the player must start a run in Green Acres with hyper mode and hurry mode enabled. Move southwest, and after precisely 10 tilesets (map tiles) and west precisely 10 tilesets, the area's appearance will change drastically. After this happens, continue moving southwest, and all the stages in the game will morph together and giant winged eyes will begin to spawn. After killing 128 of them, missingN▯ is unlocked as a playable character.
* The distance and direction the player must travel is independent of the "Visually Invert Stages" Option while Inverse Mode is enabled, unlike other location-specific Secrets.
Once unlocked, MissingN▯ can be purchased for 66,666, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, MissingN▯ can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "rightninetyseven".

characters.unlockShortPt: Com o destino mais adverso em Green Acres, foge para fora dos limites do mundo.
stepsPt: Depois de obteres o Yellow Sign, começa uma run em Green Acres com o modo hiper e o modo pressa activados.
Desloca-te para sudoeste e, ao fim de exactamente 10 tiles para sul e 10 tiles para oeste, o aspecto da área muda drasticamente.
Depois disso, continua a avançar para sudoeste — todas as fases do jogo começam a fundir-se e surgem olhos alados gigantes.
Ao matares 128 deles, o missingN▯ fica desbloqueado como personagem jogável.
A distância e a direcção a percorrer não dependem da opção "Visually Invert Stages" quando o Modo Inverso está activado, ao contrário de outros Secrets ligados a locais específicos.
Depois de desbloqueado, custa 66 666 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.description: Starts with temporarily reduced area.
characters.unlockShort: Be a good boy in Il Molise.
characters.unlockGuide:
The player must start a run in Il Molise and use Celestial Dusting to attack the enemy plants, healing them instead. Upon restoring a total of 100,000 health to the plants, Peppino is unlocked as a playable character. Playing as O'Sole Meeo can make this trivial, as it does not take damage from the plants. Beginning (X) can help speed up the process.
Once unlocked, Peppino can be purchased for 666, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Peppino can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "pinociampino".

characters.unlockShort: Complete the Collection.
characters.unlockGuide:
To unlock the Queen Sigma, it is required for the player to have unlocked every item that is listed in the "Version 1.0" section of the Collection menu, with the exception of a few items. This section only includes items available at the game's 1.0 release and not part of any DLCs.
The items in the 1.0 section that are not required to unlock Queen Sigma are:
* Super Candybox II Turbo
* Victory Sword
* Sole Solution
* Flames of Misspell
* Ashes of Muspell
Once unlocked, Queen Sigma can be purchased, although the price to purchase her is 0 and does not scale.
Alternatively, Queen Sigma can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "allatonce".
Note: It may be necessary to enter one more game and immediately quit to get the unlock to register.

A sign that Scorej-Oni is nearby is the faint sound of thunder sporadically playing in the background, though this may be difficult to hear if there are many sound effects playing at once. Defeating Scorej-Oni unlocks it as a playable character.
After unlocking, Scorej-Oni can be purchased for 5000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Scorej-Oni can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "notsureitsthunder".

characters.name: Space Dette
characters.description: Starting weapon grows stronger when levelling up. Gets more fans from defeating a large amount of enemies.
characters.unlockShort: Quickly break the bounds of Space and find Love.
characters.unlockGuide:
After unlocking Space Dude, the player must start a run in Space 54 and locate a special pillar with a pulsating icon of the Pummarola. This pillar can be found by moving less than one tile south-east (down and right) from the starting area and the player's spawning location. However, if the player has the Visually Invert Stages option enabled, and is playing in inverse mode, the pillar will instead be found by moving north-west (up and left) from the starting area. The pillar will disappear alongside the rest of the stage at 11:00.
The player can use a character that ignores walls, such as Gyoruntin, to trivialize the process. Alternatively, achieving enough Move Speed, lag, or visual clutter will also allow the player to pass through the walls of the stage. Making use of the game speed modifier granted by the Roast Chicken with a Clock in the Middle also makes traveling to the pillar easier. It should be noted that the Pummarola icon is not indicated on the Milky Way Map. Interacting with the Pummarola icon unlocks Space Dette as a playable character.
After unlocking, Space Dette can be purchased for 5,000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Space Dette can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "loveknowsnobounds".

characters.name: Toastie
characters.description: So much potential.
characters.unlockShort: 2) Uppercut a non-red reaper
characters.unlockGuide:
Before Toastie can be unlocked, the player must have unlocked Exdash Exiviiq through any method.
Upon killing The Stalker, The Drowner, or The Trickster with specific weapons or pickups that can instantly kill enemies, Toastie will appear in the bottom right corner of the screen for half a second before disappearing. In this brief timeframe, the player must quickly press the Down Arrow and Enter keys at the same time while Toastie is onscreen. The S key (the down key in the WASD configuration) does not count. On console pressing down on the "D-Pad" + "confirm button" (A for Switch and Xbox, X for PlayStation) should also work. Doing this unlocks Toastie as a playable character.
If the half-second window is too difficult, the player can enter Inlaid Library with inverse mode enabled, then go all the way to the right, past the Gold Ring, until they find The Trickster. The Trickster will appear at the second piano past the Gold Ring if the "Visually Invert Stages" option is disabled. However, if this option is enabled, The Trickster will instead appear at the third piano past the Gold Ring. The Trickster will not appear if the player has not yet defeated The Directer. Hitting The Trickster with an "insta-kill" will not kill it, but will still cause Toastie to appear, allowing the player repeated attempts in a single run.
The following weapons and items will work for unlocking Toastie:
* Rosary
* Gorgeous Moon
* Venus Crescent
* Infinite Corridor
* Crimson Shroud
* Victory Sword
* Dairy Cart
** (Note that this is not the same as Carréllo or Carrozza!, and that Dairy Carts do not appear in the Inlaid Library, assuming the player chooses the easier method.)
Once unlocked, Toastie can be purchased for 777, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Toastie can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "tramezzini" after Exdash Exiviiq, has been unlocked.

characters.name: Torino
characters.description: Evolves into JoyaTauro at lv16, and into AccumulaTori at lv36. Retaliates.
characters.unlockShort: Witness the 17th Colossus wander to new horizons.
characters.unlockGuide:
The player must start a run in Mazerella and take a specific path through the maze generally heading north, before entering a room containing the 17th Collossus. The room containing the Collossus is directly north from the starting room when using a flying character to bypass the walls. The Collossus is initially asleep and only begins to move upon being reduced to 90% of its total health.
Once the Collossus is awake, it will begin walking in a straight line directly to the bottom of the stage. It is important to keep in mind that damaging the Collossus under 75% of its total health will cause it to enrage, targeting the player and preventing the secret from completing. Instead, the Collossus must be allowed to walk beyond the southern border of the stage while it is within the screen, while the player is also standing in the area that the Collossus has destroyed. Doing so unlocks Torino as a playable character.
It is recommended for the player to use a flying character, such as Gyoruntin, or an invincible character that can avoid dealing enough damage to cause the Collossus to target them, like Megalo Menya Moonspell to complete this secret. Once the player awakens the Collossus, they should move south to the point where the Collossus eventually walks off-screen, or when the player can not move further south. Once the Collossus walks on-screen, the player can walk right behind them, unlocking Torino. It is also advised that the player does not try to do this secret in Inverse Mode, or at least does not have the 'Visually Invert Stages' option enabled on the main menu.
Room directions when not using a flying character:
* East
* North

Passing the starting room (on the west), instead continue south:
* South

* South
* West
* South
The wall to the south in this room and the next room is where the Collossus needs to be followed.
Once unlocked, Torino can be purchased for 5000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Torino can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "wanderingcolossus”.

It is important to keep in mind that damaging the Collossus under 75% of its total health will cause it to enrage, targeting the player and preventing the secret from completing.
Instead, the Collossus must be allowed to walk beyond the southern border of the stage while it is within the screen, while the player is also standing in the area that the Collossus has destroyed.
Doing so unlocks Torino as a playable character.

It is recommended for the player to use a flying character, such as Gyoruntin, or an invincible character that can avoid dealing enough damage to cause the Collossus to target them, like Megalo Menya Moonspell to complete this secret.
Once the player awakens the Collossus, they should move south to the point where the Collossus eventually walks off-screen, or when the player can not move further south.
Once the Collossus walks on-screen, the player can walk right behind them, unlocking Torino.
It is also advised that the player does not try to do this secret in Inverse Mode, or at least does not have the 'Visually Invert Stages' option enabled on the main menu.
Room directions when not using a flying character: East → North → North → East → North → North → East → East → North → West → West → North → West → South → South → West → North → North

Once the Collossus starts moving, in order to avoid damaging it by following it, take the same directions in reverse back to the starting room, but do not take the final west turn into the starting room: South → South → East → North → North → East → South → East → East → South → West → West → South → South → West → South → South
Passing the starting room (on the west), instead continue south: South → South → South → South → West → South
The wall to the south in this room and the next room is where the Collossus needs to be followed.
Once unlocked, Torino can be purchased for 5000, which scales with other characters purchased.

en.rule: Wake the 17th Colossus in Mazerella, then let it walk off the southern border without ever enraging it.

phases.title: Phase 0 — Preparation
phases.intro: Recommended, not required:

items.text: A flying character
children: Gyoruntin can bypass the maze's walls entirely.

items.text: Or an invincible character
children: Megalo Menya Moonspell can safely stand near the Colossus without risking a hit that enrages it.

phases.note: Avoid Inverse Mode for this Secret — or at least disable the "Visually Invert Stages" option.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Find and wake the Colossus
phases.intro: Start a run in Mazerella:

items.text: Reach the 17th Colossus's room

children: Directly north from the starting room.
East → North → North → East → North → North → East → East → North → West → West → North → West → South → South → West → North → North

items.text: Reduce it to 90% health
children: It's asleep until then — once it wakes, it starts walking in a straight line towards the bottom of the stage.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Let it walk off without enraging it
phases.intro: This is the part that actually unlocks Torino:

items.text: Never drop it below 75% health
children: Damaging it further enrages it — it turns to target you instead, which fails the Secret.

items.text: Retrace your path back south
children: Same directions as Phase 1, reversed, but skip the final west turn into the starting room: South → South → East → North → North → East → South → East → East → South → West → West → South → South → West → South → South
Then, instead of entering the starting room, keep going south: South → South → South → South → West → South

items.text: Follow it to the southern wall
children: The wall to the south of this room and the next is where the Colossus needs to be followed.

items.text: Let it walk off the southern border
children: While it's still on-screen, stand in the area it just destroyed — this unlocks Torino as a playable character.

phases.note: Once unlocked, Torino can be purchased for 5,000, which scales with other characters purchased.

pt.rule: Acorda o 17.º Colossus em Mazerella e deixa-o sair pelo limite sul sem nunca o enfurecer.

phases.title: Fase 0 — Preparação
phases.intro: Recomendado, mas não obrigatório:

items.text: Uma personagem voadora
children: A Gyoruntin consegue ignorar completamente as paredes do labirinto.

items.text: Ou uma personagem invencível
children: A Megalo Menya Moonspell pode ficar perto do Colossus sem risco de um golpe o enfurecer.

phases.note: Evita o Modo Inverso para este Secret — ou, pelo menos, desactiva a opção "Visually Invert Stages".

phases.title: Fase 1 — Encontra e acorda o Colossus
phases.intro: Começa uma run em Mazerella:

items.text: Chega à sala do 17.º Colossus

children: Directamente a norte da sala inicial.
Este → Norte → Norte → Este → Norte → Norte → Este → Este → Norte → Oeste → Oeste → Norte → Oeste → Sul → Sul → Oeste → Norte → Norte

items.text: Reduz a sua vida a 90%
children: Está adormecido até lá — assim que acorda, começa a andar em linha recta para o fundo da fase.

phases.title: Fase 2 — Deixa-o ir sem o enfurecer
phases.intro: É esta parte que desbloqueia mesmo o Torino:

items.text: Nunca o deixes abaixo de 75% de vida
children: Danificá-lo mais do que isso enfurece-o — passa a atacar-te, o que faz falhar o Secret.

items.text: Volta pelo mesmo caminho para sul
children: As mesmas direcções da Fase 1, ao contrário, mas sem a última viragem a oeste para a sala inicial: Sul → Sul → Este → Norte → Norte → Este → Sul → Este → Este → Sul → Oeste → Oeste → Sul → Sul → Oeste → Sul → Sul
Depois, em vez de entrares na sala inicial, continua para sul: Sul → Sul → Sul → Sul → Oeste → Sul

items.text: Segue-o até à parede sul
children: A parede a sul desta sala e da seguinte é onde tens de seguir o Colossus.

items.text: Deixa-o sair pelo limite sul
children: Enquanto ainda está no ecrã, fica na área que ele acabou de destruir — isto desbloqueia o Torino como personagem jogável.

phases.note: Depois de desbloqueado, o Torino custa 5000 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.name: Astarte
characters.description: Starts with a hidden Star Flail. Enemies have a 15% chance to spawn Defanged. Can turn defeated enemies into followers.
characters.unlockShort: Practice non-violence amongst the flowers with the charmed young Morris.
characters.unlockGuide:
After unlocking Pile of Secrets, the player must start a run as Jonathan Morris, Charlotte & Jonathan, or Jonathan & Charlotte, using one of their skins to start with a weapon selector (Morning Star, Coat of Arms, Spectral Sword, or Belnades' Spellbook) on Il Molise. The player must skip the selection of a weapon. This will lead to the player not having a starting weapon. Then, the player must avoid defeating any enemies until the timer reads at least 5:00, then quit the run.
Alternatively, Astarte can be unlocked in Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "nomancandefy".

Tens de saltar a selecção de arma.
Isto faz com que fiques sem arma inicial.
Depois, evita derrotar qualquer inimigo até o cronómetro chegar aos 5:00, e sai da run.

characters.name: Axe Armor
characters.description: Six axes axe axes as axes axe.
characters.unlockShort: Prove to them that there is something that spins better than axes.
characters.unlockGuide:
After obtaining the Pile of Secrets, the player must defeat 100 Axe Armor enemies in the Ode to Castlevania Stage with the Stellar Blade, the evolution of the Discus in the Cathedral area of the map. The Cathedral (the top part of the far east building) contains a room that only spawns Axe Armors. This spacious prayer room is located in the bottom-left area of the Cathedral with a pseudo-high / standing cross in the middle with a caped, praying statue at the base. There is also a Mirror of Truth pickup. Doing this unlocks the Axe Armor as a playable character.
Once unlocked, the Axe Armor can be purchased for 2,000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, the Axe Armor can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "missaxalotl".

characters.unlockShortPt: Prova-lhes que há algo que gira melhor do que machados.
stepsPt: Depois de obteres o Pile of Secrets, derrota 100 inimigos Axe Armor na fase Ode to Castlevania com o Stellar Blade, a evolução do Discus, na área da Cathedral do mapa.
A Cathedral (a parte superior do edifício mais a leste) tem uma sala onde só aparecem Axe Armors.
Esta sala de oração espaçosa fica na zona inferior esquerda da Cathedral, com uma cruz alta ao centro e uma estátua de capa a rezar na base.
Também há ali um Mirror of Truth para apanhar.
Fazer isto desbloqueia o Axe Armor como personagem jogável.
Depois de desbloqueado, custa 2000 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.description: Charge ability affected by Curse: triggers all equipped Dominus weapons. Immune to health drain. Flies.
characters.unlockShort: May the power of the first Belmont break her mask.
characters.unlockGuide:
After obtaining the Black Disk in Ode to Castlevania, Carmilla will appear in the stage as a boss enemy, where her summoning circle is located directly east of the Capra Gate. Upon evolving the Hex into the Nightmare and defeating her with it, Carmilla is unlocked as a playable character.
The Curse zones summoned by Nightmare must land the final hit against Carmilla. Luckily, these zones will instantly defeat Carmilla, playing a "pop" noise when it happens.
Once unlocked, Carmilla can be purchased for 16,650, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Carmilla can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "weepingmask".
steps: After obtaining the Black Disk in Ode to Castlevania, Carmilla will appear in the stage as a boss enemy, where her summoning circle is located directly east of the Capra Gate.
Upon evolving the Hex into the Nightmare and defeating her with it, Carmilla is unlocked as a playable character.
The Curse zones summoned by Nightmare must land the final hit against Carmilla.

Upon unlocking almost all the other secrets from the Ode to Castlevania DLC, Chaos is unlocked as a playable character.

characters.name: Death
characters.description: Doesn't appreciate getting blasphemously mockered.
characters.unlockShort: Make it feel at home.
characters.unlockGuide:
The player must start a run in Ode to Castlevania while playing as Richter Belmont, and then obtain the Endo Gears, Peri Pendulum, Myo Lift, and Epi Head, which are unlocked after obtaining the Serpent Gate, then evolving them into the Clock Tower and entering the boss fight against Death. Once unlocked, Death can be purchased for 16,650, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Death can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "sewardzead".

characters.name: Ferryman
characters.description: Water included.
characters.unlockShort: You don't need his services if you can walk on water.
characters.unlockGuide:
After obtaining the Pile of Secrets, the player must start a run in Ode to Castlevania and evolve the Sonic Dash into Rapidus Fio. Then, they must cross the moat in front of the castle using any method of Wall Clipping, including Flight. Note that Rapidus Fio must be active and the player must be moving. Only specific sections of the moat will unlock this secret, such as the section that connects this moat to the larger body of water to the north, or the section directly south of the bridge leading into the castle.
Once unlocked, the Ferryman can be purchased for 1,665, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, the Ferryman can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "hehhehheh".

Only specific sections of the moat will unlock this secret, such as the section that connects this moat to the larger body of water to the north, or the section directly south of the bridge leading into the castle.
Once unlocked, the Ferryman can be purchased for 1,665, which scales with other characters purchased.
characters.unlockShortPt: Não precisas dos seus serviços se conseguires andar sobre a água.
stepsPt: Depois de obteres o Pile of Secrets, começa uma run em Ode to Castlevania e evolui o Sonic Dash em Rapidus Fio.
Depois, atravessa o fosso à frente do castelo usando qualquer método de Wall Clipping, incluindo o Flight.
O Rapidus Fio tem de estar activo e tens de estar em movimento.
Só secções específicas do fosso desbloqueiam este secret, como a que liga este fosso à maior massa de água a norte, ou a que fica directamente a sul da ponte que leva ao castelo.
Depois de desbloqueado, custa 1665 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.description: He doesn't understand the game.
characters.unlockShort: Try 3000. Or 6000. Or more. hopefully their tiny ears will listen at some point.
characters.unlockGuide:
The player must defeat a total between 3,000 and 9,000 of Fleamen in the Ode to Castlevania stage. Flea Armors and Flea Riders count towards this total.
If 3,000 Fleamen have been defeated, a random number is rolled at the end of a run between 0 and 9,000. Fleaman is unlocked if the amount of Fleamen defeated is greater than the random number.
Because the random number cannot exceed 9,000, defeating over 9,000 Fleamen when a run ends guarantees unlocking the Fleaman as a playable character.
Once unlocked, the Fleaman can be purchased for 500, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, the Fleaman can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "finalboss".

characters.name: Galamoth
characters.description: Bigger is better.
characters.unlockShort: A secret so big it won't pass through the Castle's doors.
characters.unlockGuide:
After obtaining the Beast Gate and Pile of Secrets in Ode to Castlevania, Galamoth will appear in the stage as a boss enemy from his summoning circle located in the center of the Labyrinth. Upon evolving Dominus Anger, Dominus Hatred, and Dominus Agony into the Power of Sire, and allowing the Power of Sire to defeat Galamoth, Galamoth will be unlocked as a playable character.
It is recommended for the player to use Megalo Dracula for this unlock, as this character can start with all three "Dominus" weapons, making obtaining the Power of Sire incredibly easy while boasting great stat bonuses.
Once unlocked, Galamoth can be purchased for 16,650, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Galamoth can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "sizematters".

Ao evoluir o Dominus Anger, o Dominus Hatred e o Dominus Agony em Power of Sire, e deixar que o Power of Sire derrote o Galamoth, este fica desbloqueado como personagem jogável.

Recomenda-se usar o Megalo Dracula para este desbloqueio, já que esta personagem pode começar com as três armas "Dominus", tornando muito fácil obter o Power of Sire, além de ter óptimos bónus de stats.
Depois de desbloqueado, custa 16 650 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.name: Hugh Baldwin
characters.description: Adept with Valmanway. Might receive Coat of Arms as 4th level up option until Level 15.
characters.unlockShort: Cut butter with six swords forged to slay vampires.
characters.unlockGuide:
Hugh Baldwin can be unlocked by obtaining 6 "sword" weapons in the Dairy Plant, all six must be present in the weapon slot when that run ends. Only sword weapons from the base game and the Ode to Castlevania DLC qualify. "Sword" weapons include:
* Victory Sword and its gift, Sole Solution
* Heaven Sword (the evolution of Cross)
* Tyrfing and its evolution, Rune Sword
* Alucart Sworb and its evolutions, Alucard Swords and Alucard Shield
* Valmanway and its union, Million Cut
* Icebrand
* Sword Brothers and its union, Vjaya Sisters
* Confodere and its evolutions, Vol Confodere and Melio Confodere
* Claimh Solais (the evolution of Pocket Knife)
As most of the base weapons already count for this secret, adding up to more than six, and half of them can be purchased from the Master Librarian, the player should avoid picking ones that need to be evolved. While evolving and uniting is discouraged, be careful with uniting Icebrand into Ninth Circle, as it does not count as a "sword" unlike other unions of weapons that can be purchased from the Master Librarian.
Once unlocked, Hugh can be purchased for 5,000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Hugh Baldwin can be unlocked in Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "enviousblade".

As armas "espada" incluem: Victory Sword e o seu presente, Sole Solution; Heaven Sword (evolução de Cross); Tyrfing e a sua evolução, Rune Sword; Alucart Sworb e as suas evoluções, Alucard Swords e Alucard Shield; Valmanway e a sua união, Million Cut; Icebrand; Sword Brothers e a sua união, Vjaya Sisters; Confodere e as suas evoluções, Vol Confodere e Melio Confodere; Claimh Solais (evolução de Pocket Knife).
Como a maioria das armas base já conta para este secret, somando mais de seis, e metade delas pode ser comprada ao Master Librarian, deves evitar escolher as que precisam de ser evoluídas.
Embora evoluir e unir não seja aconselhável, tem cuidado ao unir o Icebrand em Ninth Circle, pois deixa de contar como "espada", ao contrário de outras uniões de armas compráveis ao Master Librarian.

characters.name: Jiangshi
characters.description: Triggers a random equipped weapon every 13th hop. Immune to health drain.
characters.unlockShort: Eat the souls of 10,000 Forest frogs.
characters.unlockGuide:
After obtaining the Pile of Secrets, the player must defeat 5,000 enemies with Dark Frogamorphosis (despite the unlock condition displaying as 10,000), the union of Anura and Soul Eater, in a single run of Mad Forest.
*Note that only the central tongue attack that insta-kills enemies is tracked as "EnemiesEatenThisRun". The frogs summoned and the aura around the player from Anura and Soul Eater, respectively, do not count.
Prioritizing this weapon is advised. Taking Randomazzo such as Gemini (I) and Sapphire Mist (I) is recommended, and few other weapons should be taken unless absolutely necessary. Lower Might can help avoid other weapons "stealing" the kills needed.
Characters such as Megalo Menya Moonspell, Young Maria Renard, and those from Emerald Diorama with a source of healing like Crystal Cries (XII) can make survival a breeze. While not applicable to every character, like those aforementioned, Endless Mode is heavily recommended, as it allows the player to ensure they get all 5000 required kills.
Alternatively, Jiangshi can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "hophophophophophophophophophophophophop".

The frogs summoned and the aura around the player from Anura and Soul Eater, respectively, do not count.

While not applicable to every character, like those aforementioned, Endless Mode is heavily recommended, as it allows the player to ensure they get all 5000 required kills.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Build for the kill count

items.text: Evolve Anura + Soul Eater into Dark Frogamorphosis
children: Prioritise getting this weapon as early as possible in the run.

items.text: Pick supporting Arcana
children: Randomazzo choices like Gemini (I) and Sapphire Mist (I) work well.
Avoid taking many other weapons unless you really need them.

items.text: Consider lowering your Might
children: Helps stop other weapons from "stealing" the kills you need tracked to Dark Frogamorphosis.

items.text: Consider a character with built-in healing
children: Megalo Menya Moonspell, Young Maria Renard, or an Emerald Diorama character with something like Crystal Cries (XII) make surviving the run much easier.

phases.intro: Start a run in Mad Forest:

items.text: Defeat 5,000 enemies with Dark Frogamorphosis's tongue attack, in a single run
children: Despite the in-game unlock text showing 10,000, the real tracked requirement ("EnemiesEatenThisRun") is 5,000.
Only the central insta-kill tongue attack counts — the frogs it summons and Soul Eater's aura don't.
Endless Mode is heavily recommended, so you have enough time to land all 5,000 kills.

pt.rule: Derrota 5000 inimigos com o ataque de língua insta-kill do Dark Frogamorphosis, numa única run em Mad Forest.

items.text: Pile of Secrets

phases.title: Fase 1 — Prepara a build para as mortes

items.text: Evolui o Anura + Soul Eater em Dark Frogamorphosis
children: Prioriza obter esta arma o mais cedo possível na run.

items.text: Escolhe Arcanas de apoio
children: Opções de Randomazzo como Gemini (I) e Sapphire Mist (I) funcionam bem.
Evita levar muitas outras armas, a menos que precises mesmo delas.

items.text: Considera baixar o teu Might
children: Ajuda a evitar que outras armas "roubem" as mortes que precisas de atribuir ao Dark Frogamorphosis.

items.text: Considera uma personagem com cura própria
children: A Megalo Menya Moonspell, a Young Maria Renard, ou uma personagem da Emerald Diorama com algo como o Crystal Cries (XII) tornam a sobrevivência muito mais fácil.

phases.title: Fase 2 — Consegue as mortes
phases.intro: Começa uma run em Mad Forest:

items.text: Derrota 5000 inimigos com o ataque de língua do Dark Frogamorphosis, na mesma run
children: Apesar de o texto de desbloqueio no jogo mostrar 10 000, o requisito real controlado ("EnemiesEatenThisRun") é 5000.
Só conta o ataque central de língua que mata instantaneamente — os sapos invocados e a aura do Soul Eater não contam.
O Modo Endless é altamente recomendado, para teres tempo suficiente para conseguir as 5000 mortes.

characters.name: Slogra and Gaibon
characters.unlockShort: Defeat Death's demonic knight duo with Dracula's smallest henchman.
characters.unlockGuide:
Slogra and Gaibon can be unlocked by defeating their boss forms in Ode to Castlevania as Fleaman.
* Although the unlock method can be daunting as it requires using one of the weakest characters in the game, it can be trivialized by the Victorian Horror (XVIII) Darkana, as it grants you a damaging aura with the potential to increase your maximum health, and effectively an extra life/screen clear for mistakes. Turning off Curse and Charm powerups should allow easy enough navigation directly to the bosses.
Once unlocked, Slogra and Gaibon can be purchased for 5,000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Slogra and Gaibon can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "platonicpartners".

characters.description: Fights well with (and against) his father.
characters.unlockShort: Save the son with holy magic before the transformation is complete.
characters.unlockGuide:
After obtaining the Pile of Secrets in Ode to Castlevania, Soleil Belmont will appear in the stage as a boss enemy, where his summoning circle is located in the Art Gallery (the middle-left of the front building). Upon evolving Refectio into Sanctuary and defeating him with its passive screen-wipe effect, Soleil Belmont is unlocked as a playable character.
Once unlocked, Soleil Belmont can be purchased for 1,665, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Soleil Belmont can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "prodigalson".
steps: After obtaining the Pile of Secrets in Ode to Castlevania, Soleil Belmont will appear in the stage as a boss enemy, where his summoning circle is located in the Art Gallery (the middle-left of the front building).

characters.unlockShortPt: Salva o filho com magia sagrada antes que a transformação se complete.
stepsPt: Depois de obteres o Pile of Secrets em Ode to Castlevania, o Soleil Belmont aparece na fase como inimigo boss, com o círculo de invocação na Art Gallery (ao centro-esquerda do edifício da frente).
Ao evoluir o Refectio em Sanctuary e derrotá-lo com o seu efeito passivo que limpa o ecrã, o Soleil Belmont fica desbloqueado como personagem jogável.
Depois de desbloqueado, custa 1665 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

Para as desbloquear, o Sanctuary tem de desferir o golpe final com o seu ataque que cobre todo o ecrã, derrotando instantaneamente a Stella e a Loretta Lecarde.

steps: After obtaining the Pile of Secrets, Stone Skull can be unlocked by defeating the Sketamari in the The Bone Zone on Inverse Mode as Shanoa.

en.rule: Defeat the Sketamari in The Bone Zone, in Inverse Mode, playing as Shanoa.

phases.title: Phase 0 — Preparation
phases.intro: Before starting, make sure you have:

items.text: Pile of Secrets
Heart of Fire (XIX) and Divine Bloodline (IX) Arcana
children: One of the best Arcana combos in the game for this fight — with proper scaling it can drop the Sketamari almost immediately upon encountering it.

phases.note: Also disable Curse for this run — remove any Curse PowerUp, and avoid a maxed Torrona's Box or a Skull O'Maniac, since every bit of Curse makes the fight harder. Enable Hyper Mode for the extra XP, but skip Hurry Mode — it speeds up how fast the Sketamari scales.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Find it without feeding it
phases.intro: Start a run in The Bone Zone with Inverse Mode enabled, playing as Shanoa:

items.text: Keep your distance from the Sketamari until you're ready to fight
children: It grows stronger by absorbing monsters it touches, so getting close too early only makes it harder.
Roughly 60,000 units of distance is safe — about 1 tileset on the pause-menu map.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Defeat it
phases.intro: Bring one of its strongest counters:

items.text: Infinite Corridor
children: Deals damage equal to half of the Sketamari's current health.

items.text: Embrace of Gaea
children: One of the most powerful options against it.

items.text: La Borra
Seraphic Cry
children: Combines a large area with high single-target damage.

items.text: Defeat the Sketamari
children: Doing so unlocks Stone Skull as a playable character.

phases.note: Once unlocked, Stone Skull can be purchased for 16,650, which scales with other characters purchased.

pt.rule: Derrota o Sketamari em The Bone Zone, no Modo Inverso, jogando como Shanoa.

phases.title: Fase 0 — Preparação
phases.intro: Antes de começares, garante que tens:

items.text: Pile of Secrets
As Arcanas Heart of Fire (XIX) e Divine Bloodline (IX)
children: Uma das melhores combinações de Arcanas do jogo para este combate — com o scaling certo, pode derrubar o Sketamari quase de imediato.

phases.note: Desactiva também o Curse nesta run — remove qualquer PowerUp de Curse, e evita um Torrona's Box no nível máximo ou um Skull O'Maniac, já que qualquer Curse torna o combate mais difícil. Activa o Modo Hyper pela experiência extra, mas evita o Modo Hurry — acelera a velocidade a que o Sketamari sobe de nível.

phases.title: Fase 1 — Encontra-o sem o alimentar
phases.intro: Começa uma run em The Bone Zone com o Modo Inverso activado, jogando como Shanoa:

items.text: Mantém a distância do Sketamari até estares pronto para o combate
children: Ele fica mais forte ao absorver monstros que toca, por isso aproximares-te demasiado cedo só torna as coisas mais difíceis.
Cerca de 60 000 unidades de distância é seguro — aproximadamente 1 tile no mapa do menu de pausa.

phases.title: Fase 2 — Derrota-o
phases.intro: Leva um dos seus contadores mais fortes:

items.text: Infinite Corridor
children: Causa dano igual a metade da vida actual do Sketamari.

items.text: Embrace of Gaea
children: Uma das opções mais poderosas contra ele.

items.text: La Borra
children: Explora a sua baixa resistência a knockback.

items.text: Seraphic Cry
children: Combina uma área grande com alto dano num só alvo.

items.text: Derrotar o Sketamari
children: Fazer isto desbloqueia o Stone Skull como personagem jogável.

phases.note: Depois de desbloqueado, custa 16 650 moedas — valor que sobe consoante o número de personagens já compradas.

characters.unlockShortPt: Mata uma esfera esquelética invertida com o Vessel of Dominus.

Once unlocked, the Succubus can be purchased for 16,650, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, the Succubus can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "thatsnotlisa".

characters.unlockGuide:
After unlocking the Pile of Secrets, the player must pass 30:00 on Ode to Castlevania as Soma Cruz. After reaching this point, the player must then defeat Zephyr, located at the bottom of the clock tower on the right side of the same stage. Doing so will unlock Zephyr as a playable character. It is recommended to attempt this with Endless Mode enabled to avoid having to deal with The Reaper.
Once unlocked, Zephyr can be purchased for 5,000, which scales with other characters purchased.
Alternatively, Zephyr can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "abouttimeyoushowedup".
